titulo: Verbs of advice and orders + present subjunctive
subtitulo: Te recomiendo que pruebes los tacos.
regla: Verbs that advise, order, allow or forbid (sugerir, recomendar, aconsejar, prohibir, permitir, ordenar, necesitar) in the present take que + present subjunctive: Te sugiero que descanses. The person gets an indirect pronoun.

bloques.texto: When you **advise, suggest, order, allow, forbid or need** someone else to do something, the action after **que** goes in the **subjunctive**.
Main verbs: **sugerir, recomendar, aconsejar, animar a, prohibir, ordenar, obligar a, permitir, necesitar, advertir**.

partes: (me, te, le...) + verb in the present

bloques.texto: After a present perfect in the main clause, both present and imperfect subjunctive are possible.
Some of these also work with an infinitive: **te prohíbo salir**, **te recomiendo descansar**.
Tip: advice is a wish for someone else, so subjunctive.

lista.es: Mi doctor me sugiere que ==haga== un curso de meditación.
lista.en: My doctor suggests I take a meditation course.

lista.es: Te recomiendo que ==compres== este otro carro. Es mucho mejor.
lista.en: I recommend you buy this other car. It's much better.

lista.es: Los animo a que ==vengan== todos a la fiesta.
lista.en: I encourage you all to come to the party.

lista.es: Le están aconsejando que no ==firme== los papeles todavía.
lista.en: They're advising him not to sign the papers yet.

lista.es: Mis papás me prohíben que ==tome== alcohol.
lista.en: My parents forbid me to drink alcohol.
I order you to come back right now.

lista.es: No le permito que me ==hable== así.
lista.en: I won't let you talk to me like that.
I need you to bring those boxes.

filas.t: Necesito que tú traer las cajas.

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: In Spanish: _They don't allow us to use our phones._
lista.r: No nos permiten que usemos el celular. / No nos permiten usar el celular.
